schemaNote: Independent Test Solution review of the Run1 AI requirement catalog.
PARTIAL_VALIDATION_WARNING: THIS IS A BR-ONLY SLICE, NOT A TEST SOLUTION VALIDATION. The Test Solution validates the complete AI artifact chain BR -> TS -> TC -> TD -> Mapping/traceability and then independently recalculates the coverage ratio. Four of those five legs are absent here. No coverage ratio may be derived from this artifact.

endGoal.statement: The Test Solution validates the full AI-generated artifact chain and independently recalculates coverage against Test-Solution-owned ATL105 rule catalogs.
endGoal.coverageRule: A BR is not covered unless its linked TS, TC and TD all resolve and share the same canonical ATL105 source anchor, including specification version.
endGoal.coverageAuthority: Coverage is recalculated by the Test Solution. AI-reported coverage percentages and approval labels are evidence under test, not inputs.
endGoal.demoStatus: Demonstration of the intake/contract gate only. Not a framework run and not a basis for any approval decision.

method.note: Pre-intake contract screen applied while the Maven build is blocked. Not a substitute for CanonicalTraceabilityValidator or the segment validators.

findings.impact: Inflates requirement counts and any count-based coverage metric.

segment111Investigation.observation: Run1 carries 768 requirements for Segment 111 against an 8-rule Test Solution catalog (96.0x).
segment111Investigation.explanation: The Test Solution catalog is envelope-only by deliberate design. Its own coverage README states the approximately 400 Appendix I Table-ID business rules for elements 111 and 113 are explicitly out of scope. Run1 enumerated exactly that excluded space.

rejectedHypothesis.hypothesis: Element-vs-segment numeric namespace collision (ENT-ELEM-111 misfiled as segment 111)
rejectedHypothesis.reason: KB field table confirms element 111 = Variable Information Indicator and element 113 = Variable Information Value, both genuine fields of Segment 111. Assignment is correct.

segment111Investigation.conclusion: The 96x ratio does not evidence AI defect. It evidences two producers working at different granularity. Using the envelope-only catalog as a coverage denominator against value-level AI requirements is an invalid comparison.
segment111Investigation.recommendedAction: Do not treat as a defect. Either exclude the Appendix I space from both sides, or extend the Test Solution catalog to cover it, before computing any Segment 111 coverage ratio.

verdictScope: Applies to BR intake eligibility only. It is not a coverage verdict and not a certification of the Run1/Run2 delivery.
verdictBasis: Blocking findings are contract-level and independent of the Java engine. The package cannot enter anchor-based comparison in its current form.
